setPin: The entry code is hashed on this device. It is never sent to a server.
setTok: Paste the token only while alone. It stays on this device so saving a product publishes price, stock and hide. Orders are not published.
needTok: Saved on this device. First time: Settings, paste the token, then save the token. After that, saving a product publishes it.
needTok2: A GitHub token is needed once, and it stays on this device.
tokSaved: Token saved on this device. Saving a product publishes it to the store.
published: Products, stock and reviews published. Orders were not. The token stayed on this device.
setSecure: Data protection: orders and customer names stay on this phone only and are never published to GitHub. Do not share order links or your GitHub token. Lock the phone. Admin is noindex. Multi-device login later: Firebase.
